recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist 1970s-style album cover featuring a central, small-scale framed portrait of a musician against a vast cream-colored field. The design is anchored by a large, expressive custom-lettered title in blue and a secondary serif subtitle, creating a balanced vertical stack of elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Large negative space surrounding a small central focal point
Dynamic, textured script contrasting with a rigid rectangular frame
Warm cream background vs. cool blue title accents
Vertical alignment of all typographic and photographic elements
coreInvariants: Thin, double-line border around the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Small rectangular portrait centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 25% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The custom-lettered title at the top center acts as the primary visual hook.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: Title -> Subtitle -> Framed Portrait -> Bottom Metadata.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extremely high; the vast cream field emphasizes the central content and creates a sense of classic simplicity.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background for a vintage paper feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Medium blue for the primary title lettering.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark charcoal or black for the secondary serif text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the background and the text.
paletteRestrictions: Muted Earth Tones in the photo

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a slight upward slant.
letterConstructionRules: Glyphs are composed of multiple parallel blue lines creating a hatched or 'corduroy' texture.
Thick, flowing strokes with exaggerated swashes on the first and last letters.
Interconnected lowercase letters with a hand-drawn, organic feel.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital letters feature long, sweeping tails that underline or overline adjacent letters.

composition.relationshipToImage: anchored to the top edge of the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, textured script paired with a conservative, high-contrast transitional serif.
graphicDevices: Thin double-line rectangular border with small corner notches.

preserve: The multi-line texture of the script
The small scale of the central photo

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, rounded serif style of the subtitle.
The main title requires a hand-drawn approach to capture the multi-line texture.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A solid cream-colored square canvas. In the center, a small vertical rectangular photograph of a man with dark curly hair playing an acoustic guitar, framed by a thin, elegant double-line border in a slightly darker cream or tan.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, blue, hand-lettered script text at the top center with a multi-line 'corduroy' texture. Below that, add a small subtitle in a bold serif font like Bookman, centered just above the photo frame.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent cream color?
Is the script text textured with parallel lines?
Is the photo frame small relative to the canvas?

adjustableVariables: Script color (e.g., changing blue to brown)
mustRedesign: Original brand logos at the bottom
Exact wording of the original title

avoid: Perfectly clean vector lines in the script

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script text does not look like a standard computer font.
Verify the double-line border is thin and subtle.
Check that the cream background feels like aged paper.
Confirm the central image is not too large.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a solid cream field, place a small framed portrait in the center, and top it with a large, textured, hand-drawn script title and a bold serif subtitle.
